Read input: origen_202272.v · Open raw
module origen_202272 (
    input clk,
    input valid,
    input [7:0] data,
    input parity,
    output reg tx,
    output reg busy
);

    parameter NCO = 7549747/2; // 115.2 kbps baud rate

    reg [10:0] phase;
    reg [10:0] prephase;
    reg [3:0] count;
    reg [7:0] tx_data;
    reg [1:0] state;

    parameter IDLE = 2'b00;
    parameter TRANSMIT = 2'b01;

    always @(posedge clk) begin
        if (state == IDLE) begin
            tx <= 1'b1;
            busy <= 1'b0;
            if (valid) begin
                tx_data <= data;
                state <= TRANSMIT;
                busy <= 1'b1;
            end
        end else if (state == TRANSMIT) begin
            phase <= (phase + 1'b1) % NCO;
            prephase <= (prephase + 1'b1) % NCO;
            if (prephase == 0) begin
                if (count == 0) begin
                    tx <= 1'b0; // Start bit
                end else if (count < 9) begin
                    tx <= tx_data[count-1];
                end else begin
                    tx <= 1'b1; // Stop bit
                end
                if (phase == 0) begin
                    count <= count + 1'b1;
                    if (count == 10) begin
                        state <= IDLE;
                        busy <= 1'b0;
                        count <= 0;
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end

endmodule
